3\. An edited hold releases paths nobody approved 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
check_sensitive reads the lead's MERGE-HOLD-<n> text as it stands when the gate runs. It then
accepts any trusted DECISION-<n> whose comment id is larger than the hold's, but editing a GitHub
comment keeps its id and parse() never reads updated_at. So if the lead edits an answered hold
to add a newly matched path, which is what the gate's own "doesn't name X (the form: …)" message
invites, the old decision passes for a path Matthew never saw. RoomLog.answers has the same gap
for top-severity owner decisions: an ESCALATION-<n> edited after the decision to name another
finding makes that decision cover it.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The gate links a DECISION to the lead's MERGE-HOLD/ESCALATION only by comparing comment ids. Edited comments keep their id, so an edit made after the decision changes what the decision appears to approve. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[203-213] - room.py[2324-2341] - room.py[2405-2423] ## Recommended Fix Have `parse()` also return `updated_at` (falling back to `created_at`). In `check_sensitive`, accept a decision only if the hold's `updated_at` is no later than the decision's `created_at`. In `RoomLog.answers`, accept only asks whose `updated_at` is earlier than the decision's `created_at`. When a hold was edited after its decision, say so in the failure and ask for a new hold and decision. Add a regression test where the fake gh returns an edited hold. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
